newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 surges one pct at open, spurred by Dow.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 surges one pct at open, spurred by Dow.

text.p: The FTSE 100 raced ahead in opening trade, spurred on by the Dow's 173-point rally, its second largest ever, dealers said.
The UK index was 40.8 points up at 4,386.9 by 0742 GMT, having opened 45.4 points ahead at 4,391.5.

"We've done well on the back of Wall Street but the futures came in a bit dull with some profit-taking as you might expect at these levels so we've come off the top and there's not much follow-through trade," said one dealer.
Gains were boosted by a poll showing opposition Labour's lead narrowed by five percent, dealers said.
